requirement_text.ISS-0329: test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs:140 sets realm = "jit-disabled-test-realm", a hardcoded literal, causing a unique constraint violation on tenants.idp_realm_id when run concurrently in test_parallel.sh with TEST_PARALLEL_N=4. The fix requires: (1) use unique_realm/1 for the realm in the JIT-disabled test body, AND (2) dynamically add the unique realm to :oidc_jit_provisioning Application config with enabled: false and clean up via on_exit. The test_parallel.sh exit-code sub-finding is RETRACTED as a misread -- no change needed for that script.

task.description:
Produce a fix design for ISS-0329. This is a TEST-only change to one file: test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs. The fix is to the 'JIT-disabled realm (403)' test at line 140.

KEY CONTEXT (from ISSUE-FIXER Step 1 diagnosis):
- Line 140: `realm = "jit-disabled-test-realm"` (hardcoded, causes cross-partition unique constraint collision)
- A naive `realm = unique_realm("jit-disabled")` is NOT sufficient because `JitProvisioningConfig.for_realm/1` falls back to `default/1` (enabled: true) for unknown realms, causing the pipeline to return 200 instead of 403
- The complete fix must also dynamically update `Application.get_env(:letflow, :oidc_jit_provisioning)` within the test body
- `auth_pipeline_test.exs:131` also hardcodes `"bpm-default"` as idp_realm_id but is already tracked under ISS-0108 -- document this finding but it is OUT OF SCOPE for this fix
- `test_parallel.sh` exit-code concern is RETRACTED (no code change needed)

DESIGN ARTEFACT: Write to `lib/letflow/design/iss0329-jit-disabled-realm-unique.md`.

The design must include:
1. Exact file to change: `test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs`
2. Exact lines to change (describe, do NOT write compilable Elixir code bodies)
3. Why unique_realm/1 alone is insufficient -- reference JitProvisioningConfig.default/1's enabled: true fallback
4. The Application.put_env pattern: add the unique realm to the :oidc_jit_provisioning config map with `%{enabled: false, default_status: :active, default_roles: []}`, and restore in on_exit
5. Ordering: the config mutation must happen BEFORE insert_tenant_for_realm!(realm) -- insert_tenant_for_realm! calls TenantProvisioning.provision_tenant_schema/1 which also sets Sandbox to :auto, so order within the test body matters
6. Scope: ONLY this one test file, ONLY this one test body. No changes to config/test.exs. No changes to lib/. No changes to scripts/.
7. Note about auth_pipeline_test.exs:131 (bpm-default) -- already tracked as ISS-0108, out of scope here
8. Note about test_parallel.sh exit-code (RETRACTED, no change needed)

DO NOT include compilable Elixir function bodies or code blocks. Use @spec and prose only.
